translations: And put your trust in the Ever-Living
the One Who does not die
with His Praise And sufficient is
puzzle.hint: A command to place trust in the Ever-Living who never dies and to glorify Him
puzzle.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
puzzle.verseEn: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -
